findings.title: Retry cleanup is not scoped to SMS reminders
findings.body: The new deleteMany OR arm is `{ retryCount: { gt: 1 } }` without `method: WorkflowMethods.SMS`. Since `retryCount` now exists on every WorkflowReminder row regardless of method, this SMS cron endpoint will delete EMAIL or WHATSAPP reminders once their retryCount exceeds 1, either now through other code paths or in the future when those methods adopt retryCount. Add `method: WorkflowMethods.SMS` (and preferably `scheduled: false`) to this arm so only failing SMS reminders are removed.

findings.title: retryCount increment is not atomic
findings.body: The code reads `reminder.retryCount` once in the initial findMany and later writes `retryCount: reminder.retryCount + 1` in both failure paths. If two cron invocations overlap and process the same unscheduled reminder, both can read the same value (for example 0) and both write 1, so the count never reaches 2 and the reminder may be retried indefinitely or scheduled multiple times. Use Prisma's atomic `increment: 1` or a conditional update instead of client-side arithmetic.

findings.title: No tests for retry/deletion behavior
findings.body: This PR changes workflow reminder deletion behavior and adds a retry limit, but there are no tests covering the two-failure deletion path, the success path, or ensuring non-SMS reminders are not deleted. Given the deleteMany can remove workflow reminders, a regression test is warranted.
